data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, CRITICAL — SUPERSEDES paths in original ACs): (1) .test-index is at the REPO ROOT (/.test-index), NOT plugins/dso/tests/.test-index. Its format is source_path:test_path[,test_path] keyed by SOURCE file (lines beginning with # are comments). (2) Add/append entries keyed by source path: 'plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh:tests/hooks/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh' (append to any existing planning-config.sh line rather than duplicating it) and 'plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh:tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh'. (3) The two suites to assert green under 'bash tests/run-all.sh' are tests/hooks/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh (task-1) and tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh (task-3) — update the integration-exemption file-path citations and AC Verify: commands to these repo-root paths.
